tool_adoption_matrix.bypass_risk: High bypass risk if standard OpenCode editor is unblocked. Invocation path: OpenCode -> steward tool-invoke cli -> RuntimeToolExecutionRunner.execute_write_file -> ToolRuntime.execute_one -> WriteFile.run. Gated by CapabilityGate (FILE_WRITE_PROPOSAL), GovernanceEngine evaluations, signed local action envelopes, permissions, and approvals. Telemetry implications: content-light result, raw writes redacted from logs, receipts stored locally.
tool_adoption_matrix.targeted_proof_required: Writing a test file through rig_write_file produces a schema-valid WriteFileReceipt with expected hash. Args schema: WriteFileArgs (path, content, overwrite, allow_overwrite_protected, expected_before_sha256). Receipt schema: WriteFileReceipt. Receipt identity exists as receipt_sha256/receipt_envelope_id. Real tests: tests/runtime/test_runtime_audit_persistence.py::test_write_file_audit. Readiness: ready_after_transport.

actions.purpose: Enumerate hardened tool capabilities available to external harnesses and their configuration status.
Invoke a Rig hardened tool with full governance, environment scrubbing, telemetry, and receipt logging.
Request a governed context envelope for an external harness session from the context assembler.

stage_a.description: Create project-local custom tools in TypeScript wrappers that translate arguments and invoke the Rig CLI gateway. Instruct OpenCode agents to use these wrappers.

stage_b.description: Block mutation bypass paths in OpenCode. Hook into tool.execute.before to intercept edit, write, or apply_patch calls directed at protected/governed repository surfaces.
stage_b.apply_patch_handling: Intercept apply_patch calls by inspecting patchText contents in the event payload, parsing target paths, checking write permissions, and directing the agent to use rig_search_replace.

stage_c.description: Evaluate transparently overriding OpenCode built-in tool names with same-name Rig custom tool wrappers.
prerequisites: Stage A and B wrappers and bypass controls are fully tested and proven in dogfooding.
Interface compatibility is verified (argument schema and return payload formats match standard OpenCode built-ins).
stage_c.risk: High. Direct overrides can degrade the agent's behavior if arguments or results do not match expectations, causing repeated loop failures.

steward_observation_receipt_alignment.handoff_reference_strategy: Steward handoff packet references Rig-owned receipt and context envelope IDs (e.g. receipt_sha256, context_id) directly rather than replicating the details of the mutations/scans in the observation JSONL stream.

context_assembler_integration.request_flow: At session initialization or loop start, OpenCode adapter invokes 'steward get-context-envelope' to retrieve a governed context packet.
context_envelope_contents: Active work lanes and collision warnings
Applicable AGENTS.md rules and project doctrine
Protected path lists and artifact families
context_assembler_integration.confidentiality_guarantee: No raw private file content, credentials, or prompts are written to the OpenCode adapter telemetry log. Telemetry logs contain only safe, content-light hashes.

targeted_tests_and_classifications.description: Verify tool-capabilities command returns the mature tools subset with parameters schema.
Verify tool-invoke for write_file validates parameters, performs the mutation, and generates WriteFileReceipt.
Verify tool-invoke for bash applies environment scrubbing, safe-path resolution, and blocks dangerous patterns.
Verify TypeScript plugin tool.execute.before hook successfully throws Error and blocks edit/write/apply_patch tools.
Verify get-context-envelope invokes the context assembler and returns a packet with repo metadata and lane warnings.

dependencies_and_telemetry_implications.redaction_implications: All adapter-level logs exclude raw file content, prompt inputs, and subprocess stdout/stderr bodies. Telemetry contains only correlation IDs and tool names.

completed_steward_v0_work: Implemented asynchronous non-blocking observation logging via fs.promises
Wired Map promise queues for per-session ordering
Added evidence_incomplete flag file propagation to handoff packet on write failures
Validated steward_profile.json instance validation using jsonschema Draft-7
proposed_next_implementation_spine_v1: Introduce tool-capabilities, tool-invoke, and get-context-envelope CLI subcommands inside rig_relay/cli/steward.py, acting as the thin serialization facade
Directly invoke the existing RuntimeToolExecutionRunner as the execution spine to avoid speculative gateway duplication
Implement Stage A TS wrappers for the 8 hardened tools under .opencode/tools/
Implement Stage B bypass control in .opencode/plugins/rig-roadmap-steward.ts

remaining_seams: Process spawn overhead (up to 2.0s timeout seam) for synchronous check-write and tool-invoke CLI gateway calls from the TypeScript plugin.
intentionally_deferred_work: Stage B bypass blocking (denying edit/write/apply_patch tools) is deferred until the search_replace vertical proof is fully verified end-to-end
Durable context-envelope convergence (using existing Steward capsule/raw evidence as adapter-specific input for first vertical proof)
